This ain’t your average mac and cheese🔥 Creamy gochujang mac & cheese topped with juicy steak and buttery shrimp, all made in a heart pan💓  The cream cheese makes it extra velvety, while the gochujang cuts through the richness with just the right amount of heat🔥 Creamy gochujang mac and cheese is my love language🍝✨Trust me—you’ll be obsessed after the first bite😍 📍Share with your pasta bestie & save this recipe for your next craving💗 ✨ Hailey’s Gochujang Cream Cheese Mac & Cheese 📝 Ingredients * 4oz elbow macaroni * 3 slices American cheese * 1 slice Colby Jack cheese * 2 tbsp cream cheese * ½–1 tbsp gochujang  * 1 cup heavy cream * 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese * ½ cup shredded mozzarella cheese * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp onion powder * ¼ tsp paprika * ¼ tsp black pepper * Salt * Grilled shrimp * Sliced steak * Parsley ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1. Add the garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Stir until the cheeses are fully melted and the mixture is smooth. 3. Pour in the heavy cream and add the cooked macaroni. Stir until the pasta is evenly coated. 4. Add ½ cup of the shredded cheddar and ¼ cup of the mozzarella, stirring until melted and silky. No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. My highly requested vodka pasta recipe!! And yes this is enough for my family of 5 and leftovers! Also if you like spicy I reccomemd adding a bit of Calabrian chili paste it’s so good! Vodka pasta recipe: Approximate ingredients:(I don’t measure and I’m heavy handed) - half a large yellow onion(diced) - At least 3 cloves of minced garlic(preferably not jarred) - 2 tbsp olive oil - 1 can of tomato paste( 8 oz) - Salt and pepper to taste(as I go) - 1 tsp of red pepper flakes(or to preference depending on how spicy you like it) - 2 shots of vodka(ish) - 1 1/2 - 2 cups of heavy whipping cream(preheated) - Pasta water(to desired consistency) - Grated Parmesan cheese(to preference) - Fresh basil to top 1. On medium low heat add 2 tbsp of olive oil to a pan. Add in onions and cook for a few minutes until they’re translucent. Once translucent add in garlic and cook until garlic is slight brown but not burnt.  2. Add a little salt and pepper at this step or throughout.  3. Start to boil your pasta. Make sure you reserve some pasta water at some point.  4. Once garlic is slightly brown/tan, still on medium low heat, add in tomato paste and red pepper flakes and mix into the onions and garlic until combined.  5. Smooth paste over the pan and increase heat just barely(medium) and let cook until tomato paste deepens in color(a few minutes). 6. Once tomato paste deepens, turn heat back to medium low, and add in vodka and mix until combined. Careful it’s on lower heat so it dosent burn.  7. Add more salt and pepper to taste.  8. Slowly add in the preheated heavy whipping cream while mixing to combine.  9. Once combined add pasta water to reach desired consistency. The sauce will start to thicken as well once cooled down so keep that in mind during this step.  10. Grate in at least a half cup of Parmesan cheese, or more if you like parm.(please no pre grated cheese, it won’t melt) 11. Spoon the pasta into the sauce. I leave mine unstrained so the extra pasta water helps emulsify the sauce even more.  12. Plate pasta and top with some fresh basil, more grated parm and maybe some burrata and olive oil if you’re feeling extra! #italian #cookwithme #sundaydinner #vodkapasta #recipe

No-Dough Dumplings (4-Layer Flour Hack) No dough, no wrappers — just flour and meat. So satisfying & surprisingly delicious 🤍 #nodoughdumplings #dumplinghack #easyrecipes #foodtiktok #satisfyingfood No-Dough Dumplings Ingredients: * 1 lb ground beef (or pork) * 1 tsp salt * Black pepper * 1 onion (grated) * Fresh parsley (finely chopped) Instructions: 1. Mix ground meat with salt, pepper, grated onion, and parsley. 2. Shape into small balls. 3. Freeze for ~30 minutes to firm up. 4. Prepare a bowl of cold water and a tray of flour. 5. Dip each meatball in water → coat in flour. 6. Repeat this water + flour coating 4 times. 7. Lightly roll each ball in your hands to smooth the shape. 8. Boil in salted water for 6–8 minutes. 9. Serve with crispy garlic chili oil mixed with soy sauce and top with green onions.
